name: comp-479

frames.best_why: All five columns fit and Name carries an ascending chevron, showing the sort state.
frames.render_note: Later frames clip the right Balance column; only frame 1 shows every column.

tagline: Wide dark table with click-to-sort headers and drag-to-resize columns.
summary: A dark account table with more columns than fit, showing name, email, country flag and city, status and balance. Clicking a header sorts the rows and drags a thin divider beside it to widen or narrow the column.
appearance: Small grey header labels sit on a slightly lighter band above five rows. Names are bold, locations start with a flag emoji, emails are cut short with an ellipsis, and balances line up at the right. Thin vertical dividers mark the column edges.
behaviour: Clicking a header sorts by that column and swaps in an up or down chevron; a second click reverses it. Dragging the divider on a header's right edge widens the column, double-clicking it restores the original width.
demo_content: Five employees (Alex Thompson, Sarah Chen, James Wilson, Maria Garcia, Lars Nielsen) with flags, emails and balances.
search_phrases: table you can sort by clicking headers
drag column dividers to resize table
data grid with sort arrows in headers
sortable columns with up down arrows
use_when: A wide record table needs click-to-sort headers and draggable column widths without adopting a full grid product.
avoid_when: Ten columns overflow a narrow screen and there is no responsive layout, so the right side clips or needs a scroll box.
customise: Columns, sort defaults and the fetch URL are fixed in the file; adding fields, changing widths or the row limit is a source edit.
weight_why: A table library sorts and resizes ten columns over five remote rows, with no animation loop.

a11y.note: Headers are focusable, sort on Enter or Space and set aria-sort, but the drag resize handles carry no label.

issues: Frames 2-6 clip the right Balance column; only frame 1 shows every column.
Every email is truncated to an ellipsis, hiding which address it is.
polish_why: Sort arrows and resize grips work well, but clipped columns and chopped emails look cramped.
